author: reek
body: HTTP server for the Market storefront. Routes requests to the appropriate handler, renders HTML via MarketHtml, and serves JSON API endpoints for AJAX operations.

author: reek
body: `http-encode` does not exist anywhere in the tree; these three were written against it and so had never compiled. They build the response directly instead, the way `Net--WebServer` does. The local `http-json` is gone rather than reimplemented: WebServer already declares one with this exact signature, and two definitions of a name in one unit are decided by which chapter the mention sits in.
